decision: Move existing KDE terminal qualification and daemon focus policy into their own modules; preserve the common dispatcher, one state flag, API consumers and transports.
reason: Desktop/client policy is mixed in general desktop observation and daemon focus_guard source. Explicit modules prevent a terminal qualification task from editing GNOME or shared input/execution.
verification: Byte/body comparison with prior definitions, equivalent root-qualified imports, unchanged canonical test identities/categories, full source/release gates and ten binaries; ordinary-launcher terminal/native controls and short browser controls with honest results.
not_tested: Mechanical isolation does not certify every terminal, fix Firefox latency/iframe or Chrome upper omnibox, establish local GNOME/Wayland/physical HID acceptance, or authorize a second runtime route.
